E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
E4Plus1.uk.description: Groom Billy shocked everyone with a piggy wedding for bride Steph. Now they look back on their oink-tastic big day. Is Billy still making up for a pig mistake? (Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Old Wagon: Claire finally gets Phil to agree to sell their old station wagon, but not before everyone takes it on one last ride down memory lane. (S2 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Kiss: In honour of her late grandmother, Gloria decides to cook traditional Colombian meals, which is met with some ribbing from Jay. And Claire becomes overbearing. (S2 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Blackpool, Antonio and ex-redcoat Jason serve controversial sushi, there's an eyebrow-raising discovery at firefighter Daz and Kim's place, and foodies Martin and Kate serve Thai treats.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mill Street Bistro (Part 2/2): In the conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with the proprietor erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet. (S6 Ep13) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Yanni's: Gordon Ramsay visits Greek restaurant Yanni's, where he clashes with owner Peter, a chef who hasn't changed his menu since the business opened in 1984. (S6 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: A lie spirals into a gigantic conflict for one couple. And with revelations happening left, right and centre, all of the relationships change irreversibly. (S9 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Message Received: Jay, Gloria and Manny challenge each other to step outside their comfort zone and try something new. Mitch and Cam's wedding is getting too big and costly. (S5 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wedding, Part 1: Mitch and Cam's big day arrives and nothing can ruin it - until nothing turns into a whole lot of somethings and puts wedding planner Pepper to the test. (S5 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Star Is Born Again: A famous and sultry movie star (guest star Marisa Tomei) swoops into town with eyes for none other than Ned Flanders, making him the envy of Springfield. (S14 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mr Spritz Goes to Washington: Krusty wreaks havoc on the political system after the Simpsons help him to get elected. (S14 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: C.E.D'oh: Mr Burns signs the nuclear power plant over to Homer after Homer goes on a course and takes advantage of the fact that Burns has a canary named as its legal owner. (S14 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: 'Scuse Me While I Miss the Sky: Lisa petitions Mayor Quimby to end Springfield's light pollution problem, which leads to unexpected problems... (S14 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Tactical Village: The officers attend mandatory training exercises where all regional precincts compete. Captain Holt becomes addicted to a game on his phone. (S1 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fancy Brudgom: Boyle asks Peralta to be his best man. Jeffords, Santiago and Gina start a new diet but struggle to stick to it. Holt helps Diaz to make a sincere apology. (S1 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Knock 'em Down: Jay agrees to join Cam's bowling team for the finals, but doesn't realise that he's not eligible to play in the league. (S6 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Integrity: Phil and Jay run an errand together to pick up Lily's hand-me-down princess castle for Joe. Phil is upset that Claire won't let him buy a videogame console. (S6 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Patriot Games: Alex faces her worst nightmare: having to share the Valedictorian title with her number one competitor, Sunjay. (S6 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Crying Out Loud: Phil, Luke and Haley force Alex to come out and celebrate her senior ditch day, but they end up taking an unexpected detour. (S6 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: No Loan Again, Naturally: When Homer and Marge's mortgage rate skyrockets, they have to put their house up for sale - and Flanders buys it and becomes their landlord. (S20 Ep12/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gone Maggie Gone: When Marge temporarily loses her sight, Homer loses Maggie to a convent and Lisa has to go undercover as a nun to find her. (S20 Ep13/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: In the Name of the Grandfather: Homer takes the family to Ireland so that Grampa can visit quaint village pub O'Flanagan's one last time. (S20 Ep14/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Wedding for Disaster: Homer and Marge discover that they're not officially married when Reverend Lovejoy finds out he wasn't a licensed minister at the time of their ceremony. (S20 Ep15/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Milhouse Doesn't Live Here Anymore: Milhouse moves away from town, and Bart comes to realise just how much his pathetic friend means to him. (S15 Ep12/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Duffless: Homer fails a breathalyser test while driving home from the Duff brewery and has to quit drinking for a month. (S4 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: With a fractious atmosphere in the air, the couples head off for a weekend retreat. And there are big questions looming for all of the newly-weds. (S19 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating: The Finale
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: It's the end-of-agency party, but who have the celebs brought as their dates? And a surprise from the agents tests the connections that have been formed. (S15 Ep20/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Bad Teacher
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2011) Naughty kids are one thing but a naughty teacher? Can titular educator Cameron Diaz win a big-bucks teaching competition... and buy surgical enhancements to seduce Justin Timberlake?
